title: atriplex hastata subsp. oppositifolia
intro: Atriplex hastata subsp. oppositifolia, commonly known as Orache, is a type of succulent plant that belongs to the Amaranthaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Orache include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in alleviating symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Orache include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
